name: Draggable Ring Carousel
description: Full-screen 3D ring of image panels that you rotate by dragging, with a staggered rise-in entry and edge vignette fading the sides into the background.
contents: Ring of image panels arranged in a circle in 3D space
Edge vignette overlay and invisible drag surface
behavior: Panels rise and fade in with a stagger on load
Dragging horizontally rotates the ring around the Y axis
Each panel's background image shifts while rotating for a parallax effect
editableByProps: Image list and number of panels
Ring radius, perspective, drag speed, entry timing
Background and vignette color, vignette width

needsCodeEdit.change: Change panel size or border and shadow styling
needsCodeEdit.where: img-node class in the images map

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the parallax strength of the background shift

fixed: Panels are fixed at 300px by 300px on a full-viewport-height root
Panels use background-size cover with a fixed 400px parallax range
